settings.text: A drawstring bucket bag in soft pebbled leather. Roomy enough for everyday, refined enough for evening.

settings.title: Details
settings.content: An everyday bucket bag with room to spare. The Portico carries soft and slouchy by day, then cinches neat for evening — an easy one-and-done for the woman on the move.

settings.title: Materials & Care
settings.content:
Material
Premium leather with hand-finished hardware.

Care
Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth and condition every 6–12 months with a neutral leather cream. Keep away from prolonged moisture.

settings.title: Shipping & Returns
settings.content:
Free shipping on all orders over $75. Once your order is placed, it ships and arrives within 7 to 10 business days.

We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for items in original, unused condition with all tags attached. Exchanges are always free. If something isn’t right, reach out — we’ll make it right.

settings.title: Two Year Warranty
settings.content:
Every Velantra bag is covered for two years against defects in materials and construction. If anything goes wrong in normal use, we’ll repair or replace it.

After two years, we continue to offer repair service for the cost of materials. Designed to last decades, not seasons.

settings.headline: Soft, Sculptural, Cinched
settings.body: A pebbled leather body that slouches in your hand and holds its line when set down. A drawstring you can work one-handed.

settings.headline: Drum-Tumbled, Not Pressed
settings.body: Most pebbled leather is embossed. Ours is tumbled for hours until the grain emerges from the hide itself. No two bags pebble the same.

settings.headline: Lined in Microsuede
settings.body: A lining that won’t shed, won’t snag, won’t bleed. Pulled out, brushed off, back to new.

settings.headline: One-handed drawstring
settings.body: Suede pull, brass-tipped, threaded through hand-set eyelets. Cinches with a tug.

settings.headline: Detachable zip clutch
settings.body: Clips inside on a leather lanyard. Pull it out, use it as a clutch on its own.

settings.headline: Adjustable strap
settings.body: Crossbody one notch, shoulder the next. Brass-set rivets — never glue.
